name: Bathurst
note: City: regional city on the Great Dividing Range, base for Mount Panorama and the heritage walks.

name: Orange
note: City: regional city known for cool-climate wine, orchards and gardens; destination-level candidate.

name: Dubbo
note: City: regional city, base for Taronga Western Plains Zoo and the Macquarie River.

name: Mudgee
note: Town: wine and produce town in hill country, base for the Mudgee wine region.

name: Lithgow
note: Town: industrial town at the foot of the Blue Mountains, base for Zig Zag Railway and Glow Worm Tunnel.

name: Cowra
note: Town: Lachlan Valley town with the Japanese Garden and breakout sites, base for the Cowra wine region.

name: Parkes
note: Town: home of the Parkes Observatory radio telescope.

name: Forbes
note: Town: Lachlan River town with the Lake Forbes billabong and museums.

name: Oberon
note: Town: small highland town used as a base for Jenolan Caves day trips.

name: Gulgong
note: Town: gold-rush heritage town with a pioneers museum and the Henry Lawson Centre.

name: Canowindra
note: Town: Lachlan River town with the Age of Fishes Museum and hot-air balloon flights.

name: Carcoar
note: Village: heritage village with a dam and several small museums.

name: Blayney
note: Town: farming town with a lookout and a river boardwalk; minor draw.

name: Condobolin
note: Town: Lachlan River town with a lookout, museums and the Utes in the Paddock art.

name: Grenfell
note: Town: named by Wikivoyage as home of the Chrysler Museum; no other visitor listing found.

name: Millthorpe
note: Village: named as a Central West village; no visitor listing in sources read.

name: Kandos
note: Town: named as a Central West township; no visitor listing in sources read.

name: Gilgandra
note: Town: named as a crossroads township on the Central West page; no visitor listing.

name: West Wyalong
note: Town: named as a Central West township; no visitor listing in sources read.

name: Lake Cargelligo
note: Town: named as a far-west Central West township; no visitor listing in sources read.

name: Stuart Town
note: Village: named as a Central West township; no visitor listing in sources read.

name: Lucknow
note: Village: named as a Central West township; no visitor listing in sources read.

name: Coolah
note: Town: named as a Central West township and gateway to Coolah Tops; no visitor listing.

name: Sofala
note: Village: gold-rush village on the Bathurst to Hill End road; no counted visitor source read.

name: Ophir Reserve
note: Reserve: site of Australia's first payable gold discovery (1851), with picnic areas and gold panning.

name: Mudgee Wine Region
note: Wine region: cellar doors and wineries around Mudgee; a destination-level candidate that the judge may fold into Mudgee.

name: Orange Wine Region
note: Wine region: cool-climate cellar doors around Orange; a destination-level candidate.

name: Cowra Wine Region
note: Wine region: 40-plus vineyards and cellar doors around Cowra; a destination-level candidate.

name: Gardens of Stone National Park
note: National park: World Heritage rock pagodas, cliffs and canyons west of Lithgow.

name: Kanangra-Boyd National Park
note: National park: sandstone walls, waterfalls and fire trails, a day trip from the Blue Mountains.

name: Goobang National Park
note: National park between Parkes, Peak Hill and Dubbo: bushwalks, lookouts and campgrounds.

name: Coolah Tops National Park
note: National park at the junction of the Warrumbungle and Liverpool ranges: waterfalls, grass trees and walks.

name: Weddin Mountains National Park
note: National park near Grenfell: a small rocky range with a scenic drive and walks.

name: Abercrombie River National Park
note: National park: river gorge park with Abercrombie Caves; destination-level candidate.

name: Wollemi National Park
note: National park: very large wilderness park reaching the Blue Mountains edge; Glow Worm Tunnel is reached from it.

name: Capertee Valley
note: Valley: large enclosed valley near Glen Davis; scenic drive and lookouts, no visitor listing read.

name: Pantoneys Crown
note: Rock mesa: lookout and walk in Gardens of Stone, named by NPWS.

name: Baal Bone Gap
note: Viewpoint: the gap and lookout named as the jewel of Gardens of Stone by NPWS.

name: Kanangra Walls
note: Cliff lookout: sheer sandstone walls at Kanangra-Boyd, named by Wikivoyage and NPWS.

name: Mount Cloudmaker
note: Mountain: named by NPWS as a walk in Kanangra-Boyd National Park.

name: Burrabadine Peak
note: Walking track and lookout peak in Goobang National Park, reached from Greenbah campground.

name: Ben Hall's Cave
note: Cave overhang and short bushwalk in Weddin Mountains National Park, a bushrangers' haunt.

name: Glow Worm Tunnel
note: Walk: disused mining railway tunnel with a colony of glow-worms, reached by footpath from a car park in Wollemi National Park.

name: Zig Zag Railway
note: Heritage railway: runs on the original zig-zag section of the western line with stations at each end; the ride is the attraction.

name: Lost City
note: Rock formations reached by fire trails above Lithgow; no official access or visitor page.

name: Blast Furnace Park
note: Park: former blast furnace converted to a park with signed walking paths.

name: Small Arms Factory
note: Museum: Lithgow Small Arms Factory museum, with guns no longer on display after a 2024 break-in.

name: Lake Lyell
note: Recreation lake: swimming, walking and a deer park near Lithgow.

name: Jannei Goat Dairy
note: Farm: goat dairy at Lidsdale; a farm venue with visits.

name: Blue Mountains SpaRadise
note: Commercial day spa (operator) near Lithgow; a venue, not a place to see.

name: Jenolan Caves
note: Show caves in a nature reserve in the Blue Mountains World Heritage area: guided cave tours, walks and Caves House.

name: Lucas Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour, known for the Cathedral chamber.

name: Orient Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour, known for its decorated chamber.

name: Temple of Baal Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour, known for its beauty.

name: Chifley Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour, one of the less strenuous tours.

name: Imperial Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour, the least strenuous of the show caves per Wikivoyage.

name: River Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour, a two-hour tour.

name: Diamond Cave
note: Show cave on a Jenolan Caves guided tour.

name: Grand Arch
note: Natural arch of about 130 m that the road passes under on entry to the Jenolan reserve.

name: Blue Lake (Jenolan)
note: Man-made lake at Jenolan, blue from limestone refraction, with walks and platypus sightings.

name: Caves House
note: Heritage hotel at Jenolan where cave tickets are sold; a hotel and restaurant, the tickets are the visitor link.

name: Six Foot Track
note: Multi-day walk from Katoomba to Jenolan Caves along the escarpment.

name: Megalong Australian Heritage Farm
note: Farm experience venue in Megalong Valley with rural activities and a restaurant.

name: Megalong Valley
note: Valley: rural valley below the Blue Mountains escarpment, reached by road from Katoomba.

name: Corridor of Oaks
note: Monument: avenue of oak trees planted by Australian prime ministers at Faulconbridge.

name: Explorers Tree
note: Historic tree west of Katoomba, said to mark where early explorers crossed the Blue Mountains.

name: Federal Pass
note: Walk: track below Leura to Wedding Veil Falls and the Federal Pass cliff line.

name: Faulconbridge Point Lookout
note: Lookout: viewpoint over the Grose River named by Wikivoyage.

name: Oaks Trail
note: Mountain bike trail: fire trail from Woodford to Lapstone, mostly downhill.

name: Cliff Drive
note: Scenic road: Cliff Drive around Katoomba and Leura with many view pull-offs; a drive, not a place.

name: The Edge Cinema
note: Cinema: IMAX screen in Katoomba showing a documentary about the Blue Mountains; a venue.

name: Bells Line of Road
note: Road: scenic road from Windsor over the Blue Mountains to Lithgow; a drive, no visitor listing read.

name: Everglades Gardens
note: Garden: historic garden at Leura with a gallery; no counted visitor source read.

name: Mount Canobolas
note: Peak: extinct volcano and highest point west of the Great Dividing Range, with summit views and day walks.

name: Cook Park
note: Park: large historic park occupying a city block in Orange.

name: Orange Botanic Gardens
note: Botanic garden: 17-hectare garden on the northern edge of Orange with summer concerts.

name: Orange Regional Art Gallery
note: Art gallery: regional gallery in Civic Square, free entry.

name: Banjo Paterson Memorial Park
note: Park: at the Narambla homestead, birthplace of poet Banjo Paterson.

name: Lake Canobolas
note: Recreation lake west of Orange with swimming, walks and a deer park.

name: Orange Adventure Playground
note: Playground: large free adventure playground next to the Botanic Gardens.

name: Mudgee Museum
note: Museum: local museum in the Colonial Inn building on Market Street.

name: St Mary of the Presentation Church
note: Church: sandstone 1857-1873 church in the town centre; a local church.

name: Louee Enduro and Motocross
note: Motocross park (operator) at Lue, about 20 minutes from Mudgee.

name: Freeflight Motorcycle Park
note: Motocross park (operator) north of Gulgong.

name: Drip Gorge Walking Track
note: Walking track near Mudgee with hiking and scenery, named by NRMA.

name: Mudgee Farmers Markets
note: Market: farmers market; trading days not confirmed in the sources read.

name: Di Lusso Estate
note: Winery: estate with a restaurant, outdoor lunch and wood-fired pizza, a few minutes north of Mudgee.

name: Moothi Estate
note: Winery: estate with a hilltop platter and valley views near Mudgee.

name: Lowe Cellar Door
note: Cellar door: certified organic and biodynamic vineyard near Mudgee.

name: Robert Stein Winery
note: Winery: cellar door near Mudgee.

name: De Beaurepaire Wines
note: Winery: cellar door near Mudgee.

name: Gulgong Pioneers Museum
note: Museum: local heritage museum on Herbert Street in Gulgong.

name: Henry Lawson Centre
note: Museum: Henry Lawson memorabilia collection in the old Salvation Army hall in Gulgong.

name: Mudgee Airshow (Wings, Wheels and Wine)
note: Event: biannual airshow at the Mudgee airport in April, not a permanent spot.

name: Mudgee Wine Festival
note: Event: annual wine festival held in late September, not a permanent spot.

name: Taronga Western Plains Zoo
note: Zoo: large open-range zoo with African and native animals, biggest tourist draw in Dubbo.

name: Dundullimal Homestead
note: Historic homestead: Dubbo's oldest building, a farmhouse from around 1840, open to visitors.

name: Old Dubbo Gaol
note: Museum: former gaol (1859-1966) with guided and self-guided tours.

name: Dubbo Observatory
note: Observatory: about 15 km out of Dubbo, for stargazing and astrophotography.

name: Royal Flying Doctor Service Visitor Experience
note: Visitor experience: Dubbo base of the Royal Flying Doctor Service with a visitor centre.

name: Dubbo History Walking Tour
note: Walking tour (operator): 2-hour self-guided pub and history walk.

name: Dubbo Farmers Markets
note: Market: held on the first and third Saturday of each month, not every day.

name: Dubbo Kart Club
note: Karting club: hire karts and events; a club, not a place.

name: Orana Dragon Boat
note: Dragon boat club paddling the Macquarie River; a community club.

name: Wellington Caves
note: Caves: guided show-cave tours (Cathedral Cave, Gaden Cave) and a discovery lab, near Wellington.

name: Burrendong Arboretum
note: Arboretum: tree collection near Burrendong Dam; no counted visitor source read.

name: Burrendong Dam
note: Dam: large water storage dam with lake recreation; no counted visitor source read.

name: Cowra Japanese Garden
wiki: Cowra Japanese Garden and Cultural Centre
note: Garden: strolling Japanese garden symbolising reconciliation, designed by Ken Nakajima.

name: Cowra Breakout Site
note: Historic site: POW camp site of the 1944 Cowra breakout, free.

name: Japanese and Australian War Cemeteries
note: Cemetery: Japanese POW cemetery and Australian cemetery at Cowra, free.

name: Lachlan Valley Railway
note: Heritage railway society: roundhouse and carriages at the old Cowra station, being restored for tourist use.

name: POW Hologram Theatre
note: Show: hologram story of the Cowra breakout at the Visitor Information Centre, donation entry.

name: Parkes Observatory
note: Radio telescope: the Dish, first telescope to detect signals from the moon, with a small museum and cafe.

name: Elvis Museum
note: Museum: Elvis memorabilia next to the Parkes tourist information centre.

name: Memorial Hill Lookout
note: Lookout: memorial lookout to Sir Henry Parkes above the town.

name: Old Parkes Post Office
note: Historic building: old post office in Parkes; exterior, not a museum.

name: Sir Henry Parkes Statue
note: Statue: memorial statue to Sir Henry Parkes in Parkes; a minor memorial.

name: Parkes Elvis Festival
note: Event: annual Elvis Festival, not a permanent spot.

name: Mayfield Garden
note: Garden: privately owned cool-climate garden with colourful flowers and quirky sculptures.

name: Oberon Museum
note: Museum: local history museum with early 20th-century models; limited opening days.

name: Oberon Tarana Rail Trail
note: Walking and cycling rail trail from Oberon.

name: Oberon Dam
note: Dam: reservoir near Oberon; named only in the Wikivoyage Oberon photo caption.

name: Lake Forbes
note: Lake: billabong winding round the Forbes town centre, used for dragon boats, jogging and cycling.

name: Plane on a Stick
note: Sculpture: the Forbes plane-on-a-stick landmark in Apex Park by the main bridge.

name: McFeeters Motor Museum
note: Museum: private collection of motor vehicles in period displays, Forbes.

name: Ben Hall Shooting Site
note: Historic site: corner of a farm with placards about bushranger Ben Hall's last hours, down a dirt road.

name: Forbes Historical Museum
note: Museum: local history museum in Forbes, short opening hours.

name: Manna Mountain
note: Hill: prominent ridge west of Forbes, climbed by a walk from a farm.

name: Age of Fishes Museum
note: Museum: one of two fish-fossil museums in the world, Devonian fish specimens.

name: Canowindra Historical Society and Museum
note: Museum: local history museum in Canowindra with limited opening days.

name: Balloon Joy Flights
note: Balloon flights (operator): hot-air balloon rides from Canowindra; the flight is the activity.

name: Canowindra International Balloon Challenge
note: Event: annual balloon challenge held late April to early May, not a permanent spot.

name: Gaskill Street
note: Heritage street: 500 m stretch of early-20th-century heritage buildings with verandahs.

name: Carcoar Dam
note: Dam: reservoir near Carcoar with a dam road.

name: Carcoar Hospital Museum
note: Museum: historic medical items in the remains of an 1861 colonial hotel.

name: Carcoar Railway Station
note: Historic station: disused station on the Blayney to Demondrille line.

name: Stoke Stable Museum
note: Museum: general town museum in a convict-built stable from 1864.

name: Carcoar Toy Museum
note: Museum: about 2000 20th-century toys and collectables, open in holiday seasons.

name: Carmenhurst Military Museum
note: Museum: military museum in the old School of Arts building in Carcoar.

name: Church Hill Rotary Lookout
note: Lookout: small lookout over Blayney, farmland and the railway line.

name: Belubula River Walk
note: Walk: 1.4 km boardwalk through open countryside beside the Belubula River.

name: Utes in the Paddock
note: Public art: about 20 painted utes in a paddock near Condobolin.

name: Reservoir Hill Lookout
note: Lookout: view over Condobolin from Reservoir Hill.

name: Lachlander Museum
note: Museum: history of the Lachlander newspaper; visits by phone appointment.

name: Condobolin and District Historical Museum
note: Museum: local history of Condobolin.

name: Condobolin Railway Museum
note: Museum: railway history of Condobolin, by arrangement, donation entry.

name: Gum Bend Lake
note: Lake: artificial lake with a 6 km walking and cycling track, free.

name: Holy Trinity Church, Kelso
note: Church: first inland church in Australia, on a hill over Bathurst with a historic cemetery.

name: Australian Fossil and Mineral Museum
note: Museum: Sommerville Collection of about 2000 fossil and mineral specimens.

name: Bathurst Regional Art Gallery
note: Art gallery: Australian art from 1955 onwards and touring exhibitions.

name: National Motor Racing Museum
note: Museum: motorcycle and car racing memorabilia at the foot of Mount Panorama.

name: Carillon War Memorial
note: Memorial: carillon war memorial to Bathurst soldiers of both World Wars.

name: St Michael and St John Cathedral, Bathurst
note: Cathedral: heritage-listed cathedral from 1861 in William Street.

name: Ben Chifley's House
note: House museum: former home of Prime Minister Ben Chifley, South Bathurst.

name: Bathurst Court House
note: Heritage building: courthouse next to Machattie Park, open most weekdays.

name: Abercrombie House
note: Historic house: 19th-century Scottish-style house on Ophir Road, furnished with imported pieces.

name: Mount Panorama Circuit
note: Motor racing circuit: public road loop around Mount Panorama, open when no races are on.

name: McPhillamy Park
note: Park: lookout over Bathurst on Mount Panorama.

name: Bathurst Miniature Railway
note: Miniature railway: runs on the 3rd Sunday of the month only, not a permanent spot.

name: Bathurst Gliding Club
note: Gliding club: one of Australia's largest, trial flights for newcomers.

name: Bathurst 1000
note: Event: annual 1000 km touring car race at Mount Panorama each October, not a permanent spot.
